name: B4000 - Managed Endpoint Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Managed Endpoint download and save_as at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down sensitive data being saved off the managed-endpoint surface to local non-sanctioned storage. Exclusions: scoped to the Managed Endpoints dataset (so unmanaged devices fall through to other controls); ships disabled — enable only after the managed-endpoint inventory is correct and downstream review surfaces are clean. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
